description: Far from the slimes you're used to, this plushie looks more like a giant, slightly flattened droplet of light blue gelatin. An expression of perfect relaxation and a cute pair of blushing dots adorn its jiggly royal figure. It takes only a glance to hear the words, "I'm not a bad slime...!"

It is a surprisingly detailed plushie of a steel broadsword, a blue eye that stares ever on adorning the center of its crossguard. A blue fabric panel stems from the pommel like a tail with which it clings onto its ancient sheath. In all... the ultimate weapon for a pillow fight.

A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a golden-eyed, light blue-haired anime girl holding a small blue slime above her head, and on the back... Nevermind. Even with there being slime absolutely everywhere, there's nothing to hide the fact that neither sets of "tools" are "equipped".

A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a rather well-developed blue-eyed and blonde-haired anime girl wearing a foreign-styled yellow police uniform, complete with a pencil skirt and white thigh highs. On the back, the same girl's eyes and uniform have both turned blood-red, her mouth open and tongue out ready to receieve... something. Blood... probably.
A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a... a janitor. He's an older fella, and judging by the magazine in his hand, he doesn't seem very reputable. ...Are you even want to see what's on the back?

A profoundly large pillow with a print of a rather dashing queen dressed in black and seated upon a cruel black throne with her legs crossed. She has blonde hair, blue eyes, a spiked reptilian tail and shell, and horns, yet on the back she's-ohmigod

A big, body-sized pillow with a print of a grizzled silver-haired, blue-gray-eyed mercenary dressed in a skin-tight sneaking suit. You can't help but feel he doesn't look very solid--at least until you turn it around and a much younger, nuder, and undoubtedly solid mercenary greets you from the underside of a half-lifted carboard box.
